notablePrerequisites:
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
Saproling Burst has at least two fade counters on it.
description:
Activate Saproling Burst by removing a fade counter from it, creating a */* Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Xavier Sal's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing the Saproling, putting a fade counter on Saproling Burst.
Repeat.
